note: Each district is a ~10 km box around its lat/lon point, not the whole district.

ndvi_method.cloud_mask: HLS Fmask bits 1-4 excluded (cloud, adjacent, shadow, snow/ice)

weather_fields.source: NASA POWER daily point data (community AG), MERRA-2 based model values, not gauge readings
weather_fields.rain_month_mm: rain per month (PRECTOTCORR sum), January first
weather_fields.days_40c_month: days per month with a daytime high (T2M_MAX) of 40 C or more
weather_fields.soil_wet_month: mean root-zone soil wetness per month (GWETROOT; 0 = dry, 1 = saturated); a model value, not SMAP
